frontmatter.title: LLM Integrations in Practice: Architecture Patterns, Pitfalls, and Anti-Patterns
frontmatter.subheading: How to integrate large language models into real systems without creating fragile, expensive messes
frontmatter.excerpt: Integrating LLMs into production systems is an engineering problem, not a demo exercise. This post covers proven integration patterns, common mistakes, and what not to build with LLMs.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
